• Led the strategic vision and decision-making for a portfolio of highly-sensitive digital transformation projects, valued at over SGD 1 million, impacting millions of stakeholders, including public servants and the general public.
  • Orchestrated the development and implementation of Gateway and Platform-based systems facilitating secure and seamless transactions related to User Authentication through Singapore's National Digital Identity Initiatives and Payment Systems, encompassing widely recognized platforms and widely adopted payment methods.
  • Played a pivotal role in ensuring the reliability and trustworthiness of systems supporting millions of daily transactions, maintaining a 99.9% uptime and delivering uninterrupted services to government agencies and citizens.
  • Catalyzed transformative digital initiatives, revolutionizing service delivery and driving organizational growth in the digital age, with a profound impact on millions of individuals.
  • Pioneered the establishment of robust systems and processes, playing a pivotal role in achieving ISO 27001 Certification for Information Security Management Systems, instilling a culture of rigorous data protection and privacy across the organization.
  • Spearheaded the development and implementation of scalable digital platforms and streamlined workflows, resulting in significant operational efficiencies, improved data accuracy, and enhanced collaboration across departments, leading to a 30% improvement in cross-department collaboration and a 20% reduction in project delivery time.

• Successfully managed and led a team of Technical Leads across the company, ensuring the welfare, progression and cohesiveness of all teams as a key member of the Management Team with Company Directors.
  • Developed and implemented training strategies that enhanced the technical capabilities of employees, resulting in increased competitiveness for the company and fair career progression for staff.
  • Provided expert advice on departmental policies and adaptations to continuously improve productivity and innovation in all functional roles within the organization.
  • Actively nurtured and mentored new Technical and Functional Leads, fostering a company culture that values risk-taking, promotes innovation and ownership across all employee levels.
  • Served as a hiring manager for technical staff, effectively determining human resources allocation across various organizational and functional units.

• Expertly managed a team of over 30 Software Engineers, effectively overseeing an extended portfolio of more than 30 active projects spanning the public and private sectors.
  • Coordinated closely with key stakeholders, including DevOps Engineers, Product Owners, Project Managers, Business Analysts and Quality Assurance Specialists, to ensure the smooth and timely delivery of all projects.
  • Proven track record of delivering projects on-time, within scope and budget, while continuously improving the process and team performance.
  • Consistently exceeded expectations by implementing best practices, standards and methodologies, resulting in increased efficiency and productivity.
  • Demonstrated strong leadership skills, effectively motivating and mentoring team members to achieve their full potential.

• Led a team of over 10 Software Engineers, effectively managing the day-to-day operations on multiple high-value projects spanning the public and private sectors.
  • Spearheaded new initiatives to build sustainable Software Engineering Teams by implementing Agile development methodologies and adopting the SCRUM framework for daily operations with CI/CD pipelines.
  • Conducted thorough Code Reviews, ensuring high-quality and efficient code in all assigned projects.
  • Demonstrated strong leadership and technical abilities, effectively managing and mentoring the team to achieve project goals.
  • Proposed and pitched new technical solutions that fulfilled various business objectives and requirements for existing and prospective clients.
  • Successfully executed and remedied issues raised during Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing for developed systems, ensuring the security and stability of the systems.
  • Assigned and implemented customised, incremental features for respective clients, each with their unique Technical Design Specifications
  • Implemented and deployed bug fixes for issues reported for ongoing and upcoming projects
